fire: There were no bison in the park until the federal government brought them back.

The new rules were approved by the federal agency last week.
School funding in England is set by the central government.
The programme is accredited by the national ministry of education.
The church was officially recognised by the government in 1905.
Each inspector is licensed by the state health department.
